description: Update a category (ids from get_item_requirements), any combination in one call: rename it; holdsItems, the container switch for its items (true = its items can hold other items: vehicles, cases, carts; false = its items are not offered as containers, even where a parent category says yes, but an item that already holds things or whose own switch says yes stays a container; null = follow the parent category again); defaultHomeLocationId, where its new items live (a location id from search_resources; null clears it); hideFieldIds / showFieldIds, inherited fields (org-wide or from a parent category; a field id or "field:<label>") this category and its sub-categories do not use: the field disappears from their items, and their values are kept and come back when it is shown again. A field defined ON this category cannot be hidden. Moving a category is app-only. Nothing is written if one part is refused. Requires the manager role. Idempotent.

defaultHomeLocationId.description: Location id new items of this category live in; null clears it

hideFieldIds.description: Inherited fields (ids or "field:<label>") this category and its sub-categories do not use

holdsItems.description: Container switch: true = its items can hold other items, false = its items are not offered as containers (an item that already holds things or whose own switch says yes stays one), null = follow the parent category

showFieldIds.description: Hidden fields (ids or "field:<label>") to show again

name: update_category

defaultHomeLocationId.description: Where its new items live; null = none set

holdsItems.description: The category's own container switch; null = it follows its parent

title: Update category
